name: Stand
dimensions: Length 22 cm; Width 10 cm; Height 15.3 cm
summary: This stand was probably intended for the display of a bronze mirror or a jade cong. It is made of moulded porcelain and is decorated in a style known as Fahua or 'Cloisonné-style decoration'.
